Shield Soldier (CV 17)

A professional guard in serviceable armor, carrying a scarred shield and an ordinary sidearm. Training and trust in the squad make this soldier more dangerous than their equipment alone suggests.

Attributes: Brawn +1; Fortitude +1; Agility +0; Guile +0; Knowledge +0; Reason +1

HP: 16 · Speed: 5 · Size: 1 (medium) · Armor DR: 2

Evasion: None · Threat: None · Stability: 0

Weaknesses: None\ Resistances: Physical (2)\ Immunities: None

Actions

Damage and effects are Weak / Standard / Strong player defense. Each slash separates one complete outcome. All attacks use the printed Threat unless stated otherwise.

Details

Measured thrust

Target: One adjacent creature. Player defense: Agility. Damage type: physical.

Shield Hunker

Before a shield-blockable attack resolves, impose 1 Bane on player attacks this shield can block until the start of its next turn. The DA judges blockability. Uses its Reaction; stacks with Defend, not another activation of itself.

Cover a Companion

The guardian steps into the line of danger, making the attacker work around its raised guard.

Before a visible enemy attacks a willing ally adjacent to this creature, impose 1 Bane on that attack roll if this creature can see the attacker. Against an NPC attack, grant that ally 1 Boon to its defense instead. This creature must also be adjacent to the attacker, or hold a shield the DA judges can obstruct the attack. No movement, target substitution or damage transfer. For a single player area attack, use the normal worst-target modifiers; do not roll again.

General details

Basic Melee: One adjacent creature; physical damage; Agility defense. Uses the printed Threat. No specialty riders.

Defend: Player attacks suffer 1 additional Bane until the start of its next turn. Combines with Evasion through normal Boon/Bane rules. Repeated Defend does not stack.

Opportunity Attack: Basic Melee against the provoking creature. Spends its Reaction before the provoking action resolves. That action continues if the creature remains capable.

Healing: Living: ordinary HP healing applies.

Senses: Ordinary sight and hearing.

Signs: Boots keep the same measured spacing in the mud.

Purpose: Hold a post and bring the squad home.

Tactics and retreat: Defend and use Shield Hunker when pressed; yield if ordered by a legitimate superior.

Counterplay and conversation: Separate the soldier from the formation or challenge the reason for the orders.

Habitat: Fort; city; road · Communication: Common

Loot: Melee weapon, shield, medium armor; 8 coins.

Summoning: Ineligible.

Design notes — not needed during play

The incoming attack names the defense attribute; use the six values above. Same targeting, costs and limits apply in either perspective. No opposed second roll.

CV worksheet

Difficulty rationale: No innate attack modifier; armor, cover and chosen actions provide its defenses. Ordinary attack difficulty; riders and positioning carry the threat.

Reference damage: 3/4/6

Reference type: physical

Expected targets: 1

Utility factor: 1.3

Action review (#1279): U 1.2 → 1.3: Maneuver allowance +0, Reaction allowance +0.1. These are provisional judgments for the changed capabilities, counting the largest increment in each category rather than adding every alternative. Reactions compete for one budget; no measured balance claim.

Regeneration per turn: 0

Reference I=3.000, O=3.162. CV uses the seed worksheet; action choices, Stability and control are not simulated. Recalibration remains required.
